Rescuing everyone costs 154 minutes of driving: 52 for the Suryagadhi round trip and 102 for the Gosaikunda round trip. Deferring the Gosaikunda group instead would cost 120 in penalties, so the full trip is cheaper than the 172 total that deferring would give. The Gosaikunda road from Myagang is passable, and the dangerous Dhunche farm road is not used. Everyone is dropped at Myagang shelter, the only designated evacuation point.

COST: 154
